metadata.description: Environment. Drives naming and, later, SKUs. Supplied by the .bicepparam file.
Workload short name. Part of every resource name. Max 12 so storage names stay <= 24 chars.
Azure region. Defaults to the resource group region; never hardcode locations in modules.
Short region code used in names (cin = Central India).
Owner tag: who to ask about these resources and who pays.
Container behind BlobStorage__ContainerName. See the container decision in Step 7.
-1 = no cap
Provision Key Vault only when the project has a real secret.
Provision Azure SQL (logical server + database). When false, no ConnectionStrings__* app settings are written.
Entra admin login for the SQL server (UPN for a user, display name for a group). From the .bicepparam / environment, not hardcoded.
Entra admin object ID (GUID).
Single-IP firewall rules (the plan outbound IPs). Never the 0.0.0.0 Allow-Azure-services rule.
Globally unique storage account name (3-24 lowercase alphanumeric).
Redundancy. LRS for dev; ZRS or GRS for prod (set in the .bicepparam).
Soft-delete retention for blobs and containers, in days.
Days after creation before quarantined files are deleted.
Standard or higher is required for slots; set per environment in the .bicepparam.
Value for ServiceBus__FullyQualifiedNamespace (output of the servicebus module).
Value for BlobStorage__ServiceUri (output of the storage module).
Azure SQL server FQDN. Empty = no SQL connection settings are written.
Globally unique logical server name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; max 63).
Entra admin login: UPN for a user, display name for a group/app. Comes from the .bicepparam (environment variable), never hardcoded.
Entra admin object ID (GUID) of the user/group/app named in adminLogin.
dev: User (lab). prod: Group (no personal admin).
Database SKU name. Serverless GP example: GP_S_Gen5_1. Provisioned GP example: GP_Gen5_2.
true = serverless (min vCores + auto-pause apply). false = provisioned.
Serverless minimum vCores, as a string because ARM needs a decimal (e.g. 0.5).
Serverless auto-pause delay in minutes. General Purpose minimum is 15; -1 disables auto-pause.
32 GB. Matches the free-offer data allowance.
Backup redundancy. dev: Local (cheapest). prod: Zone or Geo.
Use the Azure SQL Database free offer (serverless General Purpose only).
What happens when the monthly free vCore-seconds run out. BillOverUsage keeps the DB online and bills the overage.
Public IPv4 addresses allowed through the server firewall (single-IP rules). NOT the 0.0.0.0 "Allow Azure services" rule.
Daily ingestion cap in GB. -1 = no cap. Cost guard for labs.
Azure SQL server FQDN. Empty = no SQL connection setting is written.

metadata.description: Grant the staging slot identity the API roles. false = least privilege (warm-up only hits /health).
true only if the dev/admin endpoints are reachable in Azure (they call Service Bus).
Soft-delete retention in days (7-90). Soft delete itself cannot be disabled.
false for dev (deploy/delete labs reuse the name); true for prod. Cannot be turned off once enabled.
